title.narrative: Mobilize Net Zero II – Facilitating the global transport transformation

description.narrative: As a major source of greenhouse gas emissions, the transport sector is central to climate action. This project supports national governments in partner countries to align national transport policies with climate goals. It accelerates the decarbonisation of transport through international cooperation, peer learning and digital innovation. An AI-based tool increases transparency by analysing climate and transport policies and feeding them into a UN data portal based on open data standards. It also improves access to finance. With a strong focus on the private sector, it catalyses investment and promotes gender-responsive planning. By sharing tools and results through the Changing Transport platform and working through partnerships, the project ensures sustainable impact beyond its country components. It is also launching a global alliance for net-zero transport.
